description:
Nicholas, infamous for his terrible attitude, is a regular at the “Secret Club.” As usual, he comes to the club to enjoy a session with his partner, K. But the moment he steps into the room, K suddenly throws Nicholas to the floor and transforms into a terrifying presence. Flustered, Nicholas tries to get up, only for K to treat him like a criminal under suspicion of drug charges. To make matters worse, K locks Nicholas in a holding cell and tosses him, handcuffed, to the massive and intimidating Bap?!
